--Existing Trades - Suballocated

WITH SubAllocated
AS
(
	SELECT distinct a.catalyst_trade_number, CAST(b.effective_date as Date) as effective_date, b.trade_state
	FROM [ReconControl].[dbo].[tbl_Catalyst_Unallocated_Trades_London_Staging] a
	LEFT JOIN [ReconControl].[dbo].[tbl_Catalyst_Trade] b 
	ON a.catalyst_trade_number = b.parent_trade_number
	WHERE b.trade_state in ('SUBALLOCATED','CONFIRMED', 'CANCELLED')
	AND a.trade_state IS NULL


	UNION

	SELECT distinct a.catalyst_trade_number, CAST(b.effective_date as Date) as effective_date, b.trade_state
	FROM [ReconControl].[dbo].[tbl_Catalyst_Unallocated_Trades_London_Staging] a
	LEFT JOIN [ReconControl].[dbo].[tbl_Catalyst_Trade] b 
	ON a.catalyst_trade_number = b.prev_trade_number
	WHERE b.trade_state  in ('SUBALLOCATED','CONFIRMED','CANCELLED')
	AND a.trade_state IS NULL

	UNION

	SELECT distinct a.catalyst_trade_number, CAST(b.effective_date as Date) as effective_date, b.trade_state
	FROM [ReconControl].[dbo].[tbl_Catalyst_Unallocated_Trades_London_Staging] a
	LEFT JOIN [ReconControl].[dbo].[tbl_Catalyst_Trade] b 
	ON a.catalyst_trade_number = b.catalyst_trade_number
	WHERE b.trade_status  in ('CNCL')
	AND a.trade_state IS NULL

)


Update A
SET A.trade_state = B.trade_state 
       ,A.allocatedDate = CAST(B.effective_date as Date)
From  [ReconControl].[dbo].[tbl_Catalyst_Unallocated_Trades_London_Staging] A
INNER JOIN SubAllocated B
ON A.Catalyst_trade_number = B.catalyst_trade_number;



--Existing Trades - Aging

UPDATE A
SET A.aging = DATEDIFF(d, A.entry_time, CAST(GETDATE() as Date))
  FROM [ReconControl].[dbo].[tbl_Catalyst_Unallocated_Trades_London_Staging] A

INSERT INTO [Reconcontrol].[dbo].[tbl_Catalyst_Unallocated_Trades_London]
([entry_time],
	[trade_date] ,
	[settle_date] ,
	[import_source] ,
	[catalyst_trade_number] ,
	[salesperson] ,
	[counterparty] ,
	[buy_sell] ,
	[security_description] ,
	[current_par] ,
	[principal] ,
	[accrued_interest] ,
	[total_cash] ,
	[currency] ,
	[isin] ,
	[cusip] ,
	[price] ,
	[category] ,
	[aging],
	[captureDate] 
	)
SELECT [entry_time],
	[trade_date] ,
	[settle_date] ,
	[import_source] ,
	[catalyst_trade_number] ,
	[salesperson] ,
	[counterparty] ,
	[buy_sell] ,
	[security_description] ,
	[current_par] ,
	[principal] ,
	[accrued_interest] ,
	[total_cash] ,
	[currency] ,
	[isin] ,
	[cusip] ,
	[price] ,
	[category] ,
	[aging],
	[captureDate] 
FROM [Reconcontrol].[dbo].[tbl_Catalyst_Unallocated_Trades_London_Staging]
WHERE trade_state IS NULL
and entry_time >= GETDATE() - 30
